---
title: "Laporan Analisis Regresi Linear"
output:
  word_document: default
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  html_fragment: default
params:
  model: NULL
  assumption_tests: NULL
  dep_var: "Y"
  indep_vars: c("X1")
  # This new parameter controls what part of the report is rendered
  output_type: "full_report" # Can be "full_report" or "interpretation_only"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# This setup chunk runs silently and prepares the environment
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Source the centralized interpretation helper to ensure consistency
# Using here::here to make the path robust
source(here::here("R", "utils", "interpretation_helpers.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())

# Generate the core interpretation text once
interpretation_html <- interpret_regression(params$model, alpha = 0.05)
# Convert markdown-style bolding to HTML bolding for the UI
interpretation_html <- str_replace_all(interpretation_html, "\\*\\*(.*?)\\*\\*", "<strong>\\1</strong>")
interpretation_html <- str_replace_all(interpretation_html, "\\n", "<br>")

# For non-HTML outputs, we need a plain text version
interpretation_text <- interpret_regression(params$model, alpha = 0.05)
interpretation_text <- str_replace_all(interpretation_text, "\\*\\*", "")
```

```{r render-interpretation-only, eval=params$output_type == 'interpretation_only', results='asis'}
# This chunk renders ONLY the interpretation in a styled div for the Shiny UI
cat(paste0(
  "<div style='padding: 15px; background-color: #f8f9fa; border-left: 4px solid #007bff; margin: 10px 0;'>",
  interpretation_html,
  "</div>"
))
```

```{r render-full-report, eval=params$output_type == 'full_report', results='asis'}
# This chunk renders the FULL report for PDF/Word downloads
summary_reg <- summary(params$model)
```

```{r full-report-header, eval=params$output_type == 'full_report', results='asis'}
cat("# Laporan Analisis Regresi Linear Berganda\n\n")
cat(paste("**Variabel Terikat (Y):**", params$dep_var, "\n\n"))
cat(paste("**Variabel Bebas (X):**", paste(params$indep_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n\n"))
cat(paste("**Model:**", as.character(formula(params$model))[3], "\n\n"))
cat(paste("**Tanggal Analisis:**", format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y'), "\n\n"))
cat("---\n\n")
```

```{r full-report-summary, eval=params$output_type == 'full_report'}
cat("## Ringkasan Model\n\n")
model_stats <- data.frame(
    Statistik = c("R-squared", "Adjusted R-squared", "F-statistic", "p-value (F-stat)"),
    Nilai = c(
        round(summary_reg$r.squared, 4),
        round(summary_reg$adj.r.squared, 4),
        round(summary_reg$fstatistic[1], 4),
        format(pf(summary_reg$fstatistic[1], summary_reg$fstatistic[2], summary_reg$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE), scientific = TRUE, digits = 4)
    )
)
flextable(model_stats) %>% theme_vanilla() %>% autofit()
```

```{r full-report-coeffs, eval=params$output_type == 'full_report'}
cat("\n\n## Koefisien Regresi\n\n")
coeffs <- summary_reg$coefficients
coeff_df <- data.frame(
    Variabel = rownames(coeffs),
    Koefisien = round(coeffs[, "Estimate"], 6),
    `Std. Error` = round(coeffs[, "Std. Error"], 6),
    `t-value` = round(coeffs[, "t value"], 4),
    `p-value` = format(coeffs[, "Pr(>|t|)"], scientific = TRUE, digits = 4),
    Signifikansi = ifelse(coeffs[, "Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.001, "***",
        ifelse(coeffs[, "Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.01, "**",
            ifelse(coeffs[, "Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.05, "*", "")
        )
    ),
    check.names = FALSE
)
flextable(coeff_df) %>% theme_vanilla() %>% autofit()
```

```{r full-report-assumptions, eval=params$output_type == 'full_report'}
cat("\n\n## Uji Asumsi Regresi\n\n")
tests <- params$assumption_tests
if (!is.null(tests)) {
    vif_result <- if (length(params$indep_vars) > 1) paste("Max VIF =", round(max(tests$vif), 2)) else "N/A (single predictor)"
    bp_result <- paste("p-value =", format(tests$breusch_pagan$p.value, digits=4))
    shapiro_result <- if(!is.null(tests$shapiro)) paste("p-value =", format(tests$shapiro$p.value, digits=4)) else "N/A (n > 5000)"

    assumption_df <- data.frame(
        Uji = c("Multikolinearitas (VIF)", "Heteroskedastisitas (Breusch-Pagan)", "Normalitas Residual (Shapiro-Wilk)"),
        Hasil = c(vif_result, bp_result, shapiro_result)
    )
    flextable(assumption_df) %>% theme_vanilla() %>% autofit()
}
```

```{r full-report-interpretation, eval=params$output_type == 'full_report', results='asis'}
cat("\n\n## Interpretasi dan Kesimpulan\n\n")
# Use the plain text version for non-HTML reports
cat(interpretation_text)
```
